title: Apple Pie Jelly
description: This homemade apple jelly recipe is spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg and will taste just like Mom's apple pie with endless uses as a topping or filling.

steps.text: Inspect 6 (half-pint) jars for cracks and rings for rust, discarding any defective ones. Immerse in simmering water until jelly is ready. Wash new, unused lids and rings in warm, soapy water.

Combine apple juice, maple syrup, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a heavy saucepan; add pectin and bring to a rolling boil over high heat until pectin is dissolved. Slowly stir in sugar; return to a rolling boil and boil for 1 full minute.
Off heat, skim off foam with a metal spoon.

Pack jelly into hot, sterilized jars, filling to within ¼ inch of tops. Run a clean knife or thin spatula around insides of jars to remove any air bubbles. Wipe rims with a moist paper towel to remove any residue. Top with lids and screw rings on tightly.

Place a rack in the bottom of a large stockpot and fill halfway with water. Bring to a boil and lower jars 2 inches apart into boiling water using a holder. Pour in more boiling water to cover the jars by at least 1 inch. Bring to a rolling boil, cover, and process for 15 minutes.

Remove jars from the stockpot; set aside to cool, several inches apart, 12 to 24 hours. Press centers of lids with a finger to ensure lids do not move up or down. Remove rings for storage and store in a cool, dark area.
